neg.label_en: Opens by saying what death is not
neg.label_zh: 一开口，先说死亡“不是”什么

loose.label_en: Death as loosening, untying, letting go

lost.label_zh: 没有什么被摧毁、真正失去

back.label_en: Returning to the whole it came from

door.label_en: A threshold, a door, a passage
door.label_zh: 一道门槛、一扇门、一条通道

grief.label_en: The loss is real, and deserves grief
